Two more input modalities, plus a presen"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ter mode, reuse the same engine:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- **A-roll — you already have a talking-head video.** It is ASR-segmented into beats and re-styled i"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"nto the collage look, keeping the real face, lip-sync and gestures frame-for-frame (`gemini-omni-fla"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"sh/video-edit`, auto-retrying on `seedance-2.0/reference-to-video`).
- **C-roll — you have one still"},{"id":"p16s4","text":" photo** (a selfie, a product shot). The subject is cut out as a photographic sticker — never redraw"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"n — and each beat's poster is generated around it (`nano-banana-2/edit`). The narration can be clone"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"d into the subject's own voice.
- **Host — one image of a presenter.** Selected beats cut to a digit"},{"id":"p16s7","text":"al presenter who speaks the narration, lip-synced, inside the collage world (16:9 and 9:16; position"},{"id":"p16s8","text":" and size adjustable). The presenter and the world are generated as two plates and keyed together (`"},{"id":"p16s9","text":"seedance-2.0/reference-to-video` + `gemini-omni-flash/image-to-video`)."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Two ideas make or break the result, and the skill is built around both:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"1. **The look is born in the image step.** Each beat is a finished collage *poster*. All the collage"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" DNA (torn paper, cut-outs, halftone, headline text) lives in that image — if the poster isn't a ric"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"h collage, nothing downstream saves it.
2. **The motion is added after.** By default an AI video mod"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"el animates the whole poster (the "living poster" path). For dramatic *piece-by-piece* assembly, an "},{"id":"p18s5","text":"optional local keyframe engine cuts the poster into parts and drives them frame-by-frame (no content"},{"id":"p18s6","text":" filters, pixel-exact — great for real people)."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Two human decision gates keep you in control (approve the beat map; pick the style); everything else"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"sion gates keep you in control (approve the beat map; pick the style); everything else is automated."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Models (verified on Atlas Cloud)"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| Job | Model |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"| Keyframe / collage poster | `google/nano-banana-2/text-to-image` |
